title: Deceive, Detect, and Disclose: Large Language Models Play Mini-Mafia

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing trust attribution and win rates in a multi-agent social deduction game based on the specific character names (Alice, Bob, Charlie, Diana) assigned to LLM agents, mathematically modeled as an additive shift to the logit probability of winning.
Comparing the average win rates and trust attribution of LLM agents assigned male names (Bob, Charlie) against those assigned female names (Alice, Diana) during gameplay.
